Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
LSJ,
Does Reindoctrination set the Gargoyle's new slave status to Ravnos or
to Tremere/ !Tremere. It appears from the wording that it would set
the new slave status to Ravnos, since that is Mata Hari's actual clan
not the impersonated one. Is this right?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
XZealot wrote:

> LSJ,
> Does Reindoctrination set the Gargoyle's new slave status to Ravnos or
> to Tremere/ !Tremere. It appears from the wording that it would set
> the new slave status to Ravnos, since that is Mata Hari's actual clan
> not the impersonated one. Is this right?

No. If she plays it as a Tremere, then she plays it as a Tremere and,
for purposes of resolving that card, that card treats her as a Tremere.

Similarly for cases where she plays it as a Tremere antitribu.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Screaming Vermillian wrote:
> LSJ wrote:


A card she is playing sees her how she is playing it.

If it saw her Ravnosity, she wouldn't be able to play it, since it requires
a Tremere (or Tremere antitribu).

A card in play sees her how she is in play.

Reindoctrination is never put in play. It is played, it produces an effect
as it is played, and then it is gone. It never has to remember anything,
since it is only around "in the moment" it is being played.


